{{Quote|Though Karness will receive the first, I will complete more than one amulet. The second will go to Dreypa, so those two fools can battle each other unceasingly. The third shall be far stronger than the others, and it shall be mine alone.|[[Sorzus Syn]], extract from [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|Chronicle of Sorzus Syn]]|<ref name="BoS:SftDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
The '''Great Amulets''' were a group of three [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]]s created by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles|Exile]] [[Sorzus Syn]]<ref name="BoS:SftDS" /> some time after her arrival on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="JvS:TEGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> The [[Muur Talisman]], the first of the amulets created by Syn, was gifted to her fellow ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Karness Muur]], while the second&mdash;the [[Dreypa Talisman]]&mdash;was crafted specifically for [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Remulus Dreypa]]. According to [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|her chronicle]], Syn had intended to create [[Syn Talisman|the third]] for her own personal use, though the specific details of its creation were unknown to later Force users. In notes written in the margins of the ''[[Book of Sith]]'', [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] expressed hope that the Great Amulets and other artifacts like them had not survived the passage of the millennia.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />
